checks_actual_results: Implemented one local interface for nine documented event types on top of the existing MySQL outbox and in-process dispatcher; S15.1 wires the three record mutations only.

Owner created record #154, updated version 0 to 1, and soft-deleted version 1 to 2 through real runtime HTTP endpoints. MySQL contains exactly RECORD_CREATED, RECORD_UPDATED and RECORD_DELETED events for BUSINESS_RECORD:154, each PUBLISHED with retry_count 0.

The event payload stores system #151, tenant #152, module code, record ID and actor references, with no business field values, file bytes or credentials. LocalBusinessEventDeliveryTest verified listener delivery only after transaction commit callback.
Viewer create/delete returned 403 and stale owner update returned 409; the three successful event rows remained the only LOCAL_BUSINESS_EVENT rows for record #154.
After Java 21 clean package and backend restart, actuator health was UP; owner recycle-bin API returned #154, viewer returned 403, and the browser displayed #154 in the recycle bin.

A related G14 reload regression was found: route-only lifecycle retained a saved-view filter. The URL now restores an entire list-state snapshot; recycle-bin #154 and personal default view #8 both survive page reload. Frontend vue-tsc/Vite build passed.
workspace-validate and targeted git diff --check passed.
permission_or_failure_result: Viewer received 403 on create/delete and recycle-bin query; stale owner update received 409. These failed requests created no completed local business event.
remaining: Flow start/pass/reject, file-upload, import-complete and export-complete event wiring and an integrated real notification/automation subscriber remain for S15.2-S15.4; current unit listener proves the extension boundary only.
